key.name: server-credentials
key.description: Maps server origins to opaque keyring item IDs. Contains no access tokens.

key.name: credential-retry
key.summary: Retry a server after unlocking its keyring
key.description: Server origin and a unique request ID, without credentials.

key.name: subscriptions
key.description: JSON array of id, server, topic, and enabled records. Contains no credentials.

key.name: replay-state
key.description: JSON object mapping each subscribed server and topic to the time of its last handled message and recent message IDs, used to fetch messages missed while the extension was stopped. Contains no message text and no credentials.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: When false, continue receiving messages and updating recent history without sending notifications.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.description: When false, hide the top bar icon while continuing to receive messages.
